11: export function slots(resource: Resource, bookings: Interval[], length: number, grid = 15) {
12:   if (length < 1 || grid < 1) throw new RangeError("slot size");
13:   const result: Interval[] = [];
14:   for (const window of resource.opening) {
15:     for (const [start, end] of intervals.subtract(window, [...bookings, ...resource.closures])) {

26:   const candidates = slots(resources[0]!, bookings.get(resources[0]!.id) ?? [], length);
27:   return candidates.filter((candidate) => resources.slice(1).every((resource) =>
28:     slots(resource, bookings.get(resource.id) ?? [], length).some((slot) => intervals.contains(slot, candidate))));
29: }

38:   return capacity.occupied / (capacity.available + 1);

41: export function rankResources(resources: Resource[], people: number) {
42:   return resources.filter((resource) => resource.capacity >= people)
43:     .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
44: }

47:   const available = resource.opening.reduce((total, [start, end]) => total + end - start, 0);
48:   const occupied = intervals.union(bookings).reduce((total, [start, end]) => total + end - start, 0);
49:   return available ? occupied / available : 0;
50: }

52: export function chooseSlot(resource: Resource, bookings: Interval[], length: number, preferred: number) {
53:   const available = slots(resource, bookings, length);
54:   available.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a[0] - preferred) - Math.abs(b[0] - preferred) || a[0] - b[0]);

13: export function overlap(a: Interval, b: Interval) {
14:   return a[0] < b[1] && b[0] < a[1];
15: }

17: export function intersect(a: Interval, b: Interval): Interval | undefined {
18:   const start = Math.max(a[0], b[0]);
19:   const end = Math.min(a[1], b[1]);
20:   return start < end ? [start, end] : undefined;
21: }

23: export function union(intervals: Interval[]): Interval[] {
24:   const sorted = [...intervals].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
25:   const result: Array<[number, number]> = [];
26:   for (const [start, end] of sorted) {
27:     if (start >= end) throw new RangeError("empty interval");
28:     const previous = result.at(-1);
29:     if (previous && start <= previous[1]) previous[1] = Math.max(end, previous[1]);
30:     else result.push([start, end]);
31:   }
32:   return result;
33: }

35: export function subtract(window: Interval, occupied: Interval[]): Interval[] {
36:   let position = window[0];
37:   const free: Interval[] = [];
38:   for (const block of union(occupied)) {
39:     const clipped = intersect(window, block);
40:     if (!clipped) continue;
41:     if (position < clipped[0]) free.push([position, clipped[0]]);
42:     position = Math.max(position, clipped[1]);
43:   }
44:   if (position < window[1]) free.push([position, window[1]]);
45:   return free;

49:   const occupied = duration(minutes, reserve, resource);
50:   const available = Math.max(0, 480 - occupied / minuteUnit);
51:   return { occupied, available };
